items.title: The Atlanta Falcons' new profile picture becomes "the Bird Reich"
items.summary: Ahead of Sunday's 1966 throwback game, the Falcons posted "New PFP 👀" on Wednesday: their original angular falcon over red, white, black and gold stripes. That night "Falcons look like they're about to invade Poland" (156K likes) took off, and by Thursday the post had spread far past football fans and passed 26 million views (80K likes), with nearly everyone seeing Nazi iconography. Replies offered "Falcons were up 28-3 at Dunkirk," the "28-3rd Reich," "I give this a nein/10," "49ers vs 39ers" and "When your graphic designer was rejected by his dream art school" (80K), and "the Bird Reich" stuck. The team told NBC News it had no "new logo," then quietly swapped the picture for the falcon on a red helmet on Friday.
items.author: @AtlantaFalcons
